commentaries.author: वामन-जयादित्यौ
commentaries.content: भूतानद्यतनपरोक्षेऽर्थे लिटि प्राप्ते, हशश्वतोरुपपदयोर्लङ् प्रत्ययो भवति, चकाराल् लिट् च। इति ह अकरोत्। इति ह चकार। शश्वदकरोत्। शश्वच् चकार॥

commentaries.author: भट्टोजिदीक्षितः
commentaries.content: अनयोरुपपदयोर्लिङ्विषये लङ् स्यात् । इतिहाकरोच्चकार वा । शश्वदकरोच्चकार वा ॥

commentaries.author: नारायणभट्टः
commentaries.content: आभ्यां योगे लिड्विषये लङ् लिट् च स्यात् । इति हाकरोच्चकार वा । शश्वदकरोत्, शश्वच्चकार ।

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content:
And the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) comes after the verb when the particles ह and शश्वत are in connection with it and when the verb denotes past action unperceived by the speaker and before the commencement of the current day.
The force of च 'and' is that the affix लिट् (perfect) may also be employed in similar construction. As इति हाकरोत् (imperfect), or इति ह चकार (perfect) 'Alas ! he did it'. शश्वदकरोत् or शश्वच्चकार 'again and again he did it'.

commentaries.author: S.C. Vasu
commentaries.content: And the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) comes after the verb when the particles ह and शश्वत are in connection with it and when the verb denotes past action unperceived by the speaker and before the commencement of the current day.
यतो न"इतिहाऽकरोत् (भट्टिकाव्यम् 6.140) — `हशश्वतोर्लङ् च` इति भूतानद्यतनपरोक्षलिटि प्राप्ते लङ्।
